source.name: Football Shirt Culture: Brazil 2026/27 Nike Home Kit
source.quote: Nike have unveiled the Brazil 2026/27 Home kit, set for use during international fixtures including the 2026 FIFA World Cup.
source.note: Kit maker, listed as partner per the convention for kit suppliers. FSC's launch description covers every mark on the shirt - the canary yellow base with tonal knit pattern, Light Menta ribbed collar, 'The Brazil crest sits on the chest with a five star arrangement above, paired with a contrasting Nike Swoosh'. The six launch photos (worn and flat shirt, front, sleeves, shorts, socks, collar close-up) show only the Nike Swoosh, the CBF crest and an inside-collar Nike/Air 'Brasil' diamond label: no commercial sponsor on any placement.

summary: No sponsors on the shirt: Nike's canary yellow 2026 home shirt carries only the Nike Swoosh and the CBF crest; the launch photos show plain sleeves and blue shorts with just the Swoosh and CBF crest (Football Shirt Culture's launch description and images).
headline: The shirt is {level}: it carries no commercial sponsors. Nike makes the kit.
